Descrição Curta

Atuação em atividades de engenharia de pré‑comissionamento, onshore e offshore, seguindo práticas da indústria, normas técnicas e processos internos.

Trabalha integrado ao time, oferece suporte técnico, orienta engenheiros júniores e representa a empresa junto a clientes, fornecedores e demais áreas.

What experience would we like you to have?

  • Executar as atividades sem supervisão definidas dentro do projeto ou processo, com qualidade, segurança e contribuir para o cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos em cronograma. Orientar, controlar e acompanhar um time de engenheiros para entregar um escopo específico;

  • Elaborar e ser responsável por produtos (tais como especificações técnicas, planos de carregamento, planos de içamento, metodologias, task plans, listas de equipamentos, etc.) e participar da especificação de serviços, que pode incluir suporte técnico, cálculos de projeto, especificações, procedimentos operacionais, análises, relatórios de progresso, avaliações de licitação, relatórios de estudos, participar ainda de reuniões (periódicas ou não) e atender à solicitação de terceiros, dentro de suas limitações de conhecimentos técnicos;

  • Elaborar documentação técnica de projeto e assiná-la como autor/revisor. Revisar e aprovar documentação de outros engenheiros e de fornecedores. Produzir o MDR/SDR no projeto. Garantir o cumprimento das datas de emissão e revisão dos documentos;

  • Atuar e se responsabilizar pelas atividades de campo (onshore ou offshore), sempre que requerido como, por exemplo, em mobilizações e desmobilizações de equipamentos, navios, testes em equipamentos em bases de fornecedores, canteiros, etc. Supervisionar profissionais mais júniores;

  • Executar contatos com clientes, entender as necessidades destes, identificar e resolver problemas de projeto mais complexos e aprovar soluções;

  • Interagir com terceirizados, acompanhar e verificar os serviços prestados;

  • Representar a Subsea7 em reuniões com Clientes e empresas terceirizadas e discutir assuntos técnicos;

  • Conhecer e seguir os processos de engenharia apresentados no sistema de gestão de documentos da empresa (incluindo aqueles divulgados apenas no Sharepoint do departamento), assim como garantir o uso deles por engenheiros mais júniores;

  • Apresentar documentos e processos durante auditoria;

  • Acessar o COE (Community of Experts) sempre que necessário e indicar aos profissionais mais júniores como fazê-lo;


• Sugerir padronizações das rotinas de trabalho;
• Registrar, divulgar internamente e utilizar lições aprendidas em projetos;

  • Analisar criticamente todo o trabalho de engenharia realizado por terceiros, garantir a segurança nas operações e aprovar oportunidades de melhoria que otimizem o trabalho, até mesmo propondo inovações;

  • Treinar e mentorar engenheiros mais júniores e estagiários.

  • Responsabilidades e Desafios Específicos da Disciplina Contribuir na identificação de possíveis variações de escopo, registrá-las e divulgá-las ao líder da equipe de trabalho (projeto); Elaborar e aprovar o cronograma do projeto; Participar e se respons

  • Responsabiliddes e Desafios Específicos da Disciplina quando estiver offshore

  • Agir como ponto focal de contato com a engenharia onshore (ser a "ponte" entre embarcação e escritório);

An environment where you can thrive
We recognise that having a diverse team makes us a better, smarter team. Diversity is something we value and regard it as key to our success.

We encourage new ways of thinking and celebrate our wide range of skills that help us continually challenge the status quo and inspire innovation. An inclusive and diverse environment fosters creativity, improves decision-making and introduces new ways of thinking.

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Subsea7 and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive. Fair employment practices, fair treatment for all individuals and equal opportunity on the basis of merit are the foundation of how we work and develop together.

Once you have submitted your application, we will be in touch as soon as possible with next steps.

The developer will assist in delivering the technical implementation and design of D365CE solutions. They will be working with both onshore and offshore development teams. The developer will also be involved in the development of integration solutions between D365CE and various third-party legacy systems for their clients. The developer will have extensive experience with .Net, JavaScript development for D365CE. They should be aware of best practices across the development lifecycle including code management, test methodologies and build processes.

title: FF&E Procurement
description:
This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations.

Orchestrate relationships with top-tier suppliers / manufacturers and spearhead cost-effective procurement strategies tailored to the unique demands of our UTOPIA LIVING operations.

In general will be responsible for ordering, administration and supply procurement of the FF&E, OS&E, design and supply within the team.  It will be your responsibility to ensure that the orders are made on time, within budget and in the most efficient manner, ensuring that the Finance Department is kept informed of all necessary compliance.

At a glance:

  • FF&E/Fit Out Budgets and Cost Planning
  • Tendering and Market Research
  • Contracts and Purchase Orders management
  • Payment Forecast and Cost control
  • Logistic, Delivery and Installation plus Handover

You will:

  • Collaborate with Sr. FF&E Procurement Manager, Architects and Senior FF&E/Interior Designer to ascertain the timeline, budget and deadlines of the project
  • Assist the FF&E/Interior Designer with sourcing all the information necessary to complete the detailed specification document
  • Work with the design team to build the initial procurement schedule based on the review of layouts, renderings & specifications of the project
  • Responsible for the compilation of the procurement budget and coordinating all documentation ensuring all document standards are met
  • Organize the purchasing schedule, liaising with the Sr. Procurement and Project managers to ensure all project milestones are reached
  • Working closely with the Finance team to raise Funding Requests, produce purchase orders and pay proforma invoices in timely manner
  • Receive, approve and pass invoices for payment and log on procurement schedule
  • Liaise with suppliers across the globe to obtain quotes and discuss terms of service
  • To work within set budgets and timeframes, ensuring items meet the required specification and can be delivered on time
  • Liaise with internal teams and contractors to organize FF&E logistics and installation
  • Quality control
  • Ensure all supplier contacts are up to date
  • Carry out existing supplier reviews & new supplier visits in order to provide a list of approved suppliers to consideration on projects
  • Maintain accurate procurement & budget records & collate information for a weekly procurement review
Requirements
  • Bachelor's Degree in Interior Design, Architecture, Supply Chain or Logistic, preferably Master's degree in any of above
  • Project Management degree (Master's or equivalent) is a plus
  • Must have a minimum of 3 years experience within a procurement agency or design studio in a similar role.
  • Advanced/fluent in English and Portquese - required
  • Experience dealing with global projects and suppliers - markets across Europe, Brazil, DR, and Latin America advantageous.
  • Experience in establishing and executing new processes
  • Experience in preparing O&M Manuals for Hospitality projects
Benefits

Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience.

Note: Please submit your CV in English.

title: Project Engineer Integrity
description:
The Project Engineer Integrity will support offshore projects and life‑extension activities by providing practical marine and structural engineering input. The role focuses on project execution, offshore readiness, integrity assessments, inspections, repairs, and MOC support, ensuring safe and compliant implementation of structural and marine modifications.

Responsabilities:

  • Participate in concept selection, FEED, detailed design and execution of offshore brownfield and life‑extension projects.
  • Provide marine and structural engineering input for FPSOs and other offshore structures.
  • Translate engineering deliverables into offshore execution scopes, including workpacks, methodologies, inspection strategies, and lifting/installation philosophies.
  • Interface with class societies, marine warranty surveyors, and inspection vendors on structural and marine matters.
  • Review, approve or coordinate structural analysis reports, integrity assessments, repair plans, reinforcement strategies and life‑extension studies.
  • Support offshore campaigns involving inspections, repairs, modifications, installations or remediation works.
  • Work closely with marine, construction, operations, and HSE teams to ensure offshore readiness and safe execution.
  • Provide engineering support for structural integrity, reassessment, and life‑extension of offshore assets.
  • Support Management of Change (MOC) processes related to structural and marine modifications.
  • Review inspection findings and define required repair, reinforcement or mitigation actions.
  • Support troubleshooting during offshore anomalies, impacts,or structural damage events.
  • Capture lessons learned from offshore activities and incorporate them into project practices and design standards.
Requirements

Education:

  • BSc or MSc in Civil, Structural, Offshore, or Marine Engineering.
  • Advanced degrees in Offshore Structures or Systems are considered a strong advantage.
  • Extensive relevant experience may compensate for formal education.

Experience:

  • Experience in oil & gas, ideally with offshore brownfield or FPSO background.
  • Proven experience with:

FPSOs, semisubmersibles or topside structures

Structural integrity and reassessment

Life-extension and RBI activities

Offshore inspections and repair campaigns

  • Experience working with class societies and offshore regulatory frameworks.
  • Strong exposure to project execution and offshore operations, not only design.

Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of:

Offshore steel structures

Structural integrity, fatigue, buckling, and yielding

Marine and structural interfaces

  • Familiarity with international standards and practices (e.g. ABS, API, ISO, DNV).
  • Experience with structural analysis and FEM tools (e.g. FEMAP/NX, ANSYS, ABAQUS).
  • Solid understanding of offshore inspection methodologies and repair techniques (including composite repairs).

Descrição da vaga

  • Analisar projetos e desenhos técnicos de sistemas HVAC e utilidades, assegurando conformidade com normas nacionais e internacionais.
  • Supervisionar a instalação de sistemas de ar-condicionado (VRF, split, chillers, fancoils, AHU/UTA), ventilação e exaustão em ambientes comerciais, industriais ou institucionais e sistemas de filtragem de ar.

  • Realizar inspeções técnicas em dutos, equipamentos e componentes de HVAC, garantindo a qualidade da instalação.

Qualificações

  • Experiência comprovada em supervisão de projetos HVAC e sistemas de utilidades.
  • Desejável experiência em projetos e/ou obras de indústrias farmacêuticas, laboratórios, hospitais e similares;
  • Graduação em Engenharia Mecânica, Elétrica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento técnico em sistemas de ar-condicionado central, automação predial, ventilação e exaustão.
  • Familiaridade com normas técnicas (ASHRAE, ABNT, NR-13, NR-35, entre outras).
  • Experiência com sistemas de proteção contra incêndio será um diferencial.
  • Domínio das ferramentas do Microsoft Office.

title: AZZAS 2154 | Grupo Soma | LABS | Especialista de AI
description:
Descrição da vaga

Inquietos e Acelerados. Criativos ou Cartesianos. Talentosos e Autodidatas. Artesanais ou Tecnológicos. Não importa: gostamos de diversidade e de quem está aqui para agregar.

Porque GENTE É O QUE SOMA.

Estamos construindo o time de AI que vai transformar a forma como a empresa resolve problemas reais, toma decisões e opera no dia a dia. Nosso objetivo é levar a inteligência artificial para além de experimentos, tornando seu uso prático, responsável e parte natural da rotina das áreas. Aqui, AI é ferramenta de impacto: usada com senso crítico, foco em valor e liberdade para experimentar, aprender e evoluir continuamente.

Se você gosta de construir soluções, explorar novas possibilidades e aplicar AI de forma concreta, esse é o lugar.

QUER FAZER PARTE DESTA JORNADA COM A GENTE?

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Você será o
pilar técnico e cultural de AI da empresa
, responsável por definir, evoluir e governar a stack de AI, acelerando os times de projeto e garantindo que a adoção de AI aconteça com qualidade técnica, segurança e impacto real no negócio — sem burocracia excessiva.

Esse papel é
hands-on por natureza
, com forte viés de arquitetura e evangelização, atuando como referência técnica e catalisador da maturidade de AI na companhia.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de AI da empresa.
  • Estabelecer diretrizes de governança técnica, avaliando riscos em soluções de AI.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para analistas e times de tecnologia, apoiando decisões arquiteturais e desbloqueando problemas complexos.
  • Acompanhar ativamente a evolução do ecossistema de AI (GenAI, agentes, plataformas, frameworks) e desafiar continuamente a stack atual.
  • Atuar em casos estratégicos ou de maior risco, seja de forma direta ou consultiva.
  • Promover upskilling técnico e cultural, ajudando a tornar AI parte da rotina de diferentes áreas, não apenas da tecnologia.
  • Traduzir conceitos técnicos complexos de AI em implicações práticas de negócio, risco e escalabilidade.

Requisitos e qualificações

REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS:

  • Experiência sólida em engenharia de software e/ou engenharia de dados.
  • Capacidade de desenhar e implementar soluções de AI end-to-end, usando código, plataformas e ferramentas de forma pragmática.
  • Vivência com arquiteturas modernas de dados e AI (cloud, pipelines, APIs, automações, agentes).
  • Forte domínio de pensamento arquitetural, trade-offs técnicos e avaliação de riscos.
  • Facilidade em usar modelos de AI para acelerar desenvolvimento em múltiplas linguagens.
  • Aplicação prática de soluções de AI a problemas reais.

REQUISITOS COMPORTAMENTAIS:

  • Perfil naturalmente curioso e engajado com novas soluções de AI.
  • Comunicação clara e didática com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Capacidade de influenciar sem autoridade formal.
  • Pragmatismo: buscar a melhor solução possível.
  • Postura de parceiro.

Informações adicionais

NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS:
Além de trabalhar no maior grupo de moda do Brasil, focado em impulsionar talentos e especializado em fazer gigante, por aqui você também ganha:

Vale Refeição ou Refeitório;

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (apólice coletiva opcional);

Day-off no seu aniversário para você curtir muito;

Formato híbrido, para você trabalhar de onde quiser;

Até 50% de desconto nas nossas marcas;

PLR, de acordo com a nossa política;

Vagas de estacionamento e van no fim do dia, para te levar até o metrô mais próximo;

Cursos, palestras e Trilhas de Desenvolvimento, ao vivo e na nossa plataforma de conteúdo;

Avaliação de desempenho;

Muita visibilidade e exposição positiva, pra você conseguir se conectar com todo mundo sem muita hierarquia.

GRUPO SOMA agora É AZZAS 2154 FASHION & LIFESTYLE

Impulsionar o poder criativo da moda brasileira para o mundo

Somos apaixonados por criar, inovar e transformar o mundo da moda com estilo, propósito e gente boa.

Por aqui, acreditamos no poder das ideias, na força da colaboração e na beleza da diversidade. Valorizamos quem faz, quem pensa diferente, quem aprende todos os dias e quem topa evoluir junto.

DESCRIÇÃO
Executar trabalhos de alvenaria, concreto e outros materiais, guiando-se por desenhos, esquemas e especificações, utilizando processos e instrumentos pertinentes ao ofício, para construir, reformar ou reparar prédios e obras similares; Verificar as características da obra, examinando a planta e especificações, para orientar-se na escolha do material apropriado e na melhor forma de execução do trabalho; Misturar cimento, areia e água, dosando as quantidades de forma adequada, para obter a argamassa a ser empregada no assentamento de alvenaria, tijolos, ladrilhos e materiais afins; Construir alicerces, empregando pedras ou cimentos, para formar a base de paredes, muros e construções similares; Assentar tijolos, ladrilhos ou pedras; Rebocar as estruturas construídas;

WELCOME TO SITA

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR RESUME IN ENGLISH

ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM

Responsible for supporting the commercial management of business opportunities across the full opportunity and proposal lifecycle, as part of the Commercial Management Team dedicated to the C&DE portfolio.

The role plays an active part within the Bid Team, contributing to the development of commercially sound, competitive, and compliant proposals by shaping pricing, commercial assumptions, and overall deal structure, in line with customer requirements and SITA's corporate and governance guidelines

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Develop and execute deal strategies for complex, renewal, and new business opportunities.
  • Define deal structure, pricing, and competitive positioning in collaboration with Sales and Business Development.
  • Prepare and analyze commercial proposals for management review.
  • Assess financial, contractual, regulatory, delivery, and lifecycle impacts of deals.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather inputs and meet customer requirements.
  • Support the bid project plan and contribute to proposal development as part of the Bid Team.
  • Consolidate inputs from partners, subcontractors, and third parties into the proposal.
  • Develop and maintain financial models, including pricing, capex, and cash flow analysis.
  • Ensure compliance with governance, bid processes, and approval frameworks.
  • Communicate progress, risks, and issues clearly to management and stakeholders.

Qualifications:

ABOUT YOUR SKILLS

  • B. A. or equivalent professional qualifications in Engineering, Economics, Business Administration, Finance or Legal
  • At least 2 years of commercial, pricing, bid or proposal experience with project management abilities.
  • Must have sound understanding in Sales Cycles, Proposal Management, Business Development and Account Management
  • Experience in aviation industry or IT is a plus.
  • Relevant understanding of the airport and/or airline operation is an advantage.
  • Ability in developing successful relationships at Senior Manager level.

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

Employee Wellbeing: We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.

Professional Development: Level up your skills with our training platforms, including LinkedIn Learning

Competitive Benefits: Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.

title: Wireless Architect
description:
Job Title: Wireless Domain Architect (Arista focused)
Location: Brazil (Must be located in Brazil)
Role: 90 Day Contract to Hire (Potential to convert from Contract to Full Time Employee with benefits)
Position Overview
The Wireless Domain Architect is a senior, hands-on technical leadership role within a professional IT services organization, serving as the technical authority for enterprise wireless architecture. This position demands expertise in Arista's next-generation wireless platforms, with demonstrable experience designing, deploying, and supporting Arista Cognitive Wi-Fi and CloudVision Cognitive Unified Edge (CV-CUE) solutions.
The role blends solution design, field deployment leadership, pre-sales technical scoping, and escalation support, operating as both an architect and hands-on technical mentor to delivery teams.
Core Responsibilities
Wireless Architecture & Design
Serve as the primary wireless domain expert, with deep, hands-on experience in Arista Wireless architecture, hardware, and cloud-managed technologies
Design enterprise-grade wireless solutions leveraging Arista's cognitive networking capabilities, including:
CloudVision Cognitive Unified Edge (CV-CUE) centralized management, orchestration, and AI/ML-driven automation planes
Cognitive Wi-Fi platforms that provide data-driven telemetry, real-time analytics, and automatic optimization of wireless connections as network conditions evolve
Multi-radio, multifunction AP deployments with support for cutting-edge standards such as Wi-Fi 6E and Wi-Fi 7, zero-touch onboarding, and high-density coverage models
Develop high-level and low-level wireless designs (HLDs/LLDs) incorporating:
RF design, capacity planning, AP placement, and cognitive tuning mechanisms
Zero Trust and WIPS security configurations integrated with cloud orchestration
Flexible data path options and scalable control-plane architectures inherent to CloudVision's cognitive approach
Deployment Leadership & Technical Execution
Lead and direct wireless deployment efforts in customer environments and ensure alignment to Arista cognitive design principles
Mentor and guide junior engineers through:
Zero-touch provisioning and onboarding of Arista AP platforms via CV-CUE
Implementation of AI/ML-enabled analytics and automated remediation features
Integration of AP connectivity with hosted identity management and external NAC solutions
Validate configurations and deployments to ensure stable, optimized performance across cognitive AP platforms and centralized CloudVision management \
Pre-Sales Scoping & Technical Support
Participate in pre-sales scoping calls with sales and delivery leadership
Provide detailed input on:
The effort required to transition customers from legacy Wi-Fi environments to Arista, Cisco, Aruba and other OEM's or managed architectures
Level of Effort (LOE) estimation for discovery, design, deployment, optimization, and cutover phases
Validate technical assumptions for proposals and SOWs based on real experience with Arista cloud-native wireless technologies
Escalation & Customer Assurance
Serve as the escalation point for delivery issues related to:
Wi-Fi behavior under load and real-world spectrum conditions
Automation orchestration failures or troubleshooting of AI/ML-driven recommendations
Cross-domain issues spanning wired/wireless convergence and identity enforcement
Engage directly in customer escalation calls to remediate issues, restore confidence, and guide recovery
Required Technical Expertise (Priority Order)
Arista Wireless – REQUIRED / NON-NEGOTIABLE
Hands-on design, deployment, and operational experience with:
Arista Cognitive Wi-Fi access point platforms (Wi-Fi 6/6E/7)
CloudVision Cognitive Unified Edge (CV-CUE) centralized management and cognitive analytics
AI/ML-driven automation, telemetry, and troubleshooting inherent to Arista cognitive networking
HPE Aruba Wireless
Enterprise Aruba wireless design and deployment experience
Juniper Wireless
Familiarity with Juniper Mist and related wireless platforms
Cisco Wireless
Experience with Cisco enterprise wireless architectures
Nile Wireless
Exposure to or hands-on experience with Nile wireless solutions
Required Qualifications
Track record of enterprise wireless design and deployment, with at least the majority of experience on Arista cognitive wireless solutions
Demonstrable ability to lead design and delivery teams and mentor engineers in real time
Communication skills to interact confidently with technical and executive stakeholders
Ability to balance design, deployment, and escalation responsibilities simultaneously
Preferred Qualifications
Prior experience in IT professional services or consulting
Multi-vendor wireless migration expertise
Wireless certifications, particularly with Arista technologies
Experience developing technical scoping documentation, proposals, and LOE estimates
Role Characteristics
Combination of technical leadership, hands-on execution, pre-sales engagement, and post-deployment escalation support
Acts as the architectural authority for Arista wireless engagements
Expected to deliver high-quality outcomes while transferring knowledge to delivery teams

title: SDGs Analysis Consultant
description:
This job is with United Nations, an inclusive employer and a member of myGwork – the largest global platform for the LGBTQ+ business community. Please do not contact the recruiter directly.
Result of ServiceThe SDG Analysis Consultant reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under this Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the project's team and the operational, technical, and communications teams of UN-Habitat Brazil in Rio de Janeiro. He/She may also collaborate with municipal and state government officials, media, and civil society organizations.
Work LocationHome based
Expected durationSeven (7) months
Duties and ResponsibilitiesBackground The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Program (UN-Habitat) is to promote the sustainable development of human settlements and policies that lead to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners to implement the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient, and connected places, with better opportunities, where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan, and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin America and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative and socially fairer urban economic, social and environmental policies. UN-Habitat initiated a project with the State Government of Rio de Janeiro (Governo do Estado do Rio de Janeiro – GERJ) that aims to strengthen urban resilience in the State of Rio de Janeiro based on the implementation of the 2030 Agenda and the New Urban Agenda principles. The project Inclusive and Sustainable Rio helps the State to achieve urban prosperity while implementing global sustainable urban development agendas. In particular, the proposal focuses on increasing its urban resilience through the development of disaster prevention and mitigation actions. The "Voluntary Local Reviews on the SDGs developed for the State of Rio de Janeiro and a regional territorial unit" is part of the Inclusive and Sustainable Rio initiative. Its primary byproduct is a report aiming at providing technical guidance, building local capacities, being a tool to strengthen connections, alliances and collaboration between local and state governments focused on the review of the implementation of the SDGs and the Agenda 2030 locally. To support the implementation of this project and UN-Habitat's mandate in Brazil, an SDGs Analysis Consultant is required to work on the "Voluntary Local Reviews on the SDGs developed for the State of Rio de Janeiro and a regional territorial unit". Report to UN-Habitat Manager The SDGs Analysis Consultant reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The SDG Analysis Consultant will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Write a report concerning the a regional territorial unit and the State of Rio de Janeiro. b) Analyse the data and systematise it according to the characteristics of the regional territorial unit and the State of Rio de Janeiro. c) Visit selected regional territorial unit to validate the information and discuss priority projects. d) Prepare and organize participatory technical workshops. e) Provide, when possible, an integrated perspective on basic urban services such as housing, mobility, energy, water, sanitation, etc. and their vulnerability to extreme weather events. f) Support reports to partners, internal reports, etc. at various stages of the projects. g) Be responsible for maintaining an organized and accessible information file. h) Maintain close communication with counterparts and local partners, such as the governments, civil society organizations, universities, private sector, etc. i) Be responsible for ensuring that all activities observe the principles of integrity of the United Nations. j) Participate in weekly virtual meetings—and occasionally in-person meetings—held during regular working hours throughout the product development phase, upon request. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The SDGs Analysis Consultant shall assist in the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1 – Situation Analysis Report Description: The situational analysis serves as a diagnostic of existing data and policies and their alignment with the SDGs, with the aim of establishing subnational coherence with the 2030 Agenda and identifying opportunities for action. The Situation Analysis Report must contain: (i) collection of information to identify indicators, policies and instruments related to the objectives of the VLR; (ii) alignment with the SDGs and other measurement tools for tracking progress towards the 2030 Agenda; (iii) availability and identification of data sources to assess data accessibility, quality, and availability, preferably disaggregated by population subgroups and geographic areas; (iv) prioritization and selection of indicators; (v) analysis of secondary data and policies, including, where possible, an assessment of their alignment with the VLR objectives, while highlighting successes, gaps and areas for potential improvement; and (vi) mapping of relevant stakeholders. The Situation Analysis Report will consist of two (2) separate volumes — one for each territory (the State of Rio de Janeiro and a regional territorial unit) — each including an introduction and a brief explanation of its role within the overall set. The two volumes must be submitted in .docx format, following the structure defined in the methodology and in accordance with the Brazilian technical standards ABNT NBR 14724:2024 and NBR 10520:2025. A corresponding bibliographic reference file in .bib format must accompany each volume. Further formatting instructions, including a Report Template, may be provided by the UN-Habitat product team. Expected delivery date: 90 days after signing the contract. Product 2 – State of Rio de Janeiro and regional territorial unit Voluntary Local Report (preliminary version) Description: The State of Rio de Janeiro and regional territorial unit Voluntary Local Report (preliminary version) must contain: (i) in-person workshops for stakeholders to assess the Situation Analysis Report of the VLR; (ii) complete review and analysis of all collected data and its relation to the SDGs; (iii) strategic vision for the state government, considering the collected evidence to understand the current status of the 2030 Agenda in the state; and (iv) recommendations to achieve the SDGs, establishing specific actions and paths to achieve the SDGs, filling the existing gaps identified. The output will consist of two (2) separate volumes — one for each territory (the State of Rio de Janeiro and a regional territorial unit) — each including an introduction and a brief explanation of its role within the overall set. The two volumes must be submitted in .docx format, following the structure defined in the methodology and in accordance with the Brazilian technical standards ABNT NBR 14724:2024 and NBR 10520:2025. A corresponding bibliographic reference file in .bib format must accompany each volume. Further formatting instructions, including a Report Template, may be provided by the UN-Habitat product team. Expected delivery date: 120 days after signing the contract. Product 3 – State of Rio de Janeiro and regional territorial unit Voluntary Local Report (final version) Description: The State of Rio de Janeiro and regional territorial unit (final version) must contain: (i) consolidation of deliverables (products 1 and 2), adjusting to the revisions requested by the UN-Habitat team and the Government of Rio de Janeiro; (ii) in-person workshops for stakeholders to present the preliminary content of the VLR and strengthen institutional capacities to implement the 2030 Agenda in the state; and (iii) an executive summary synthesizing the overall performance of government policies within the SDGs, key findings, recommendations, and challenges to strengthen the localization of the policies. The output will consist of two separate volumes — one for each territory (the State of Rio de Janeiro and a regional territorial unit) — each including an introduction, an executive summary of up to five pages, and a brief explanation of its role within the overall set. All volumes must follow the templates adopted by UN-Habitat. The two volumes must be submitted in .docx format, following the structure defined in the methodology and in accordance with the Brazilian technical standards ABNT NBR 14724:2024 and NBR 10520:2025. A corresponding bibliographic reference file in .bib format must accompany each volume. Additional formatting instructions, including a Report Template, may be provided by the UN-Habitat product team. Expected delivery date: 180 days after signing the contract.
Qualifications/special skillsEducation Required:
Bachelor's degree in Public Administration, Economics, International Relations, Architecture and Urbanism, Geography, Urban Planning, Social Science, Political Science or related fields is required.
Postgraduate degree (Latu Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Public Administration, Economics, International Relations, Architecture and Urbanism, Geography, Urban Planning, Social Science, Political Science or related fields is required, or additional three (3) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement. Work experience:
A minimum of six (6) years of professional experience in Urban and Regional Planning, working within or in close collaboration with public administration at the federal, state, and/or municipal levels, is required.
Experience in work involving knowledge of and engagement with Brazil's National Urban and Environmental Policies, particularly their respective instruments, is required.
Experience in work related to international, national, and subnational good practices on Voluntary Local Reviews (VLRs) is required.
Experience in public policy analysis and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), with demonstrated expertise in intersectoral approaches, monitoring and evaluation, and the analysis and development of indicators and scenarios is required.
Previous experience in social mobilization and participatory activities involving public officials, civil servants, and civil society is required.
Professional or academic experience — such as research positions — in urban-environmental public policy and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) is required.
Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
Proficiency in technological tools such as Microsoft Windows, Microsoft Office (especially Excel and Word), and referencing and formatting tools such as Bib Tex is required.
Exceptional narrative report writing and editing skills, as well as proficient use of Brazilian Portuguese, are required.
Knowledge and experience in qualitative and quantitative analysis of socioeconomic indicators are required.
Knowledge and experience in handling databases from Population Censuses, administrative records, and other statistical surveys are required.
Previous research experience aligned with the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development and the New Urban Agenda is desirable.
Knowledge and experience with the administrative divisions and territorial organization of the State of Rio de Janeiro are desirable.
Good command of programming and data analysis in R software is desirable.
Good handling of online event and conference tools is desirable.
Good knowledge of project management methodologies is desirable. Competency:
Professionalism: experience working in inter-institutional environments; project management; monitoring and evaluation; and the development of approaches and strategies related to good urban governance and local and regional development.
Planning and Organization: professional approach to work and a strong sense of responsibility, with the ability to operate independently. Proven organizational skills and the capacity to manage workload efficiently and meet established deadlines.
Communication: ability to write clearly and effectively; actively listen and interpret messages accurately; respond appropriately; demonstrate openness in sharing information and keep relevant stakeholders informed. Strong abstract reasoning skills and a proven ability to produce written materials tailored to diverse audiences.
Teamwork: ability to work collaboratively within teams; demonstrate leadership, conflict resolution, and consensus-building skills; work effectively in multicultural and multi-ethnic environments while respecting diversity. Demonstrates sensitivity to the mainstreaming of vulnerability and a willingness and ability to operate in challenging contexts. Knowledge Management:
The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to the project development.
The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.
Languages
English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required. Working knowledge of English and Spanish is desirable.

Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. Remuneration LICA 3 – BRL: Total net amount). UNOPS Salary Scale. title: analista ambiental
description:
A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos , de 04/03/1966, de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.
A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.
A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.
Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.
Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.
Responsabilidades e atribuições

title: Quality Assurance Engineer –  Tech Consulting
description:
Job Description
Do you have a strong background in quality assurance, a structured approach to testing, and want to join one of the largest technology companies in the Nordics? Then this is the role for you.
We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer who wants to be part of Tieto Tech Consulting. Tieto Tech Consulting works as a true partner, solving clients' toughest technology challenges and delivering reliable outcomes that drive measurable results. By combining engineering excellence with disciplined quality practices, we support customers developing and operating critical digital platforms.
In this role, you will work in close collaboration with product, engineering, and design teams, ensuring high quality, reliability, and scalability of backend services in a modern cloud-based environment.
When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as a Quality Assurance Engineer, you will
Partner with product, engineering, and design teams to refine user stories, ensuring acceptance criteria are clear, complete, and testable.
Conduct daily evaluations of the QA swimlane in JIRA for new feature work and collaborate with engineers to execute test cycles.
Design, develop, and document comprehensive test plans and test cases for new and existing backend services.
Develop and maintain Postman API tests and automated integration test suites targeting backend services and data flows across AWS components (SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, EventBridge).
Implement and manage API contract testing to validate integrations and ensure data consistency across internal and external services.
Design, execute, and maintain performance, load, and stress tests for critical backend infrastructure to ensure scalability and reliability.
Collaborate with engineering teams to define and test security, access control, and compliance requirements (e.g. HIPAA) for backend services handling sensitive data.
Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) to establish continuous quality gates and support safe, frequent deployments.
Manage initial release completion, acting as the first quality gate by approving tickets when testing passes or returning them for rework when defects are identified.
Collaborate with QA Engineers across squads to ensure a consistent and high-quality experience for both patient- and provider-facing features.
Who We Are Looking For
Experienced QA professional with 5+ years of experience in startup or fast-paced environments, combining strong manual testing skills with automated testing capabilities.
At least 3 years of hands-on experience testing AWS-based backend architectures using Kubernetes.
Strong understanding of testing patterns for distributed systems and AWS services such as SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, and EventBridge.
Proficiency in a modern programming language such as Python, Java, or TypeScript for writing and maintaining automated test suites.
Proven experience designing and implementing automated integration, end-to-end, and component tests.
Experience with performance, load, and stress testing applied to backend infrastructure.
Hands-on experience with API contract testing frameworks.
Working knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.
Familiarity with agile development practices and bug tracking tools (e.g. JIRA, BrowserStack).
Strong analytical mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
Detail-oriented in test execution and thorough in documentation.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.
Experience in the healthcare domain is considered an advantage.
As a person, you are a team player who takes responsibility for quality, works in a structured and disciplined manner, and communicates clearly. You value accuracy, reliability, and continuous improvement in everything you do.
We offer
We offer professional growth, meaningful projects, an open culture, and a strong work-life balance. You will have the opportunity to work in a growing and future-oriented sector, contributing to high-impact digital solutions. We provide a hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working, and we believe in curiosity and continuous learning as technology evolves.
Location: Asunción, Paraguay (Hybrid)
We perform background checks on all final candidates.
Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.
Additional Information
At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

title: Associate - Global Mobility Services - Immigration
description:
Vialto Partners is a market leader in global mobility services. Our purpose is to 'Connect the world'. We are unique and the only stand-alone global mobility business. This presents a rare opportunity for our clients, stakeholders and colleagues.
Our teams help companies streamline and effectively manage their global mobility programs in a cost-efficient and compliant manner. Our services focus on providing cross-border compliance and risk assessment for tax, immigration, business travel, rewards and compensation, and remote work.
Working at Vialto Partners is about getting the chance to be part of a global and dynamic team. Globally, Vialto Partners has over 6,500 staff in over 50 countries around the world, and continues to grow. You will work with clients from a range of industries and different geographical locations. We believe in connecting the world and supporting our colleagues to do the same in their careers by undertaking assignments and opportunities globally that broaden their skills and ultimately benefit our clients.
Vialto is unstoppable when we work together in a culture of belonging, where everyone can thrive. We encourage employees to bring their true selves and share their unique talents and expertise to positively impact the communities we serve.
To learn more about what we do, tune in to our podcast On the Move to hear expert insights on issues affecting global mobility, and read about the latest news in the industry. You can also follow us on Linkedin and Instagram.
Job Description
As a Senior Associate, you will work as part of a team of problem solvers with extensive tax and consulting experience, helping our clients meet their individual income tax compliance obligations. You will address complex tax issues from strategy to execution, ensuring a smooth and efficient process. Building trusted relationships and fostering team success are essential parts of this role.
Responsibilities for this position include but are not limited to:
Assist clients in their individual income tax compliance obligations, including preparation of individual income tax computations and returns, and handling correspondence with the respective tax authorities.
Act to resolve issues which prevent effective team working, even during times of change and uncertainty.
Coach others and encourage them to take ownership of their development.
Analyze complex ideas or proposals and build a range of meaningful recommendations.
Address sub-standard work or work that does not meet company's/client's expectations.
Develop a perspective on key global trends, including globalization, and how they impact the company and our clients.
Manage a variety of viewpoints to build consensus and create positive outcomes for all parties.
Focus on building trusted relationships.
Uphold the company's code of ethics and business conduct.
Qualifications
An interest in upskilling for a digital world and technology trends, an openness to learning new tools and adapting how you work.
A demonstrated commitment to valuing differences, developing and coaching diverse teams, and ensuring diverse perspectives are heard.
Experience in expatriate tax; knowledge in Taiwan personal income tax represents an advantage.
2+ years of relevant experience for senior position.
Candidates with less experience will be considered for the position of associates.
Proven ability to manage multiple assignments, clients and staff.
Strong analytical, organization and communication skills.
An ability to work effectively under pressure and a proactive attitude.
Fluent in Portuguese.
Fluent in English.
Education/ Graduation: Business, Law, Economy, International Relations.
Demonstrated business development skills and enthusiasm about contributing to the growth of the Global Mobility Services practice.
Additional Information
Location: São Paulo - SP and surrounding areas.
We are an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status.
Please note, AI is used as part of the application process.

description:
Descrição da vaga
Inquietos e Acelerados. Criativos ou Cartesianos. Talentosos e Autodidatas. Artesanais ou Tecnológicos. Não importa: gostamos de diversidade e de quem está aqui para agregar.
Porque GENTE É O QUE SOMA.
Buscamos uma pessoa desenvolvedora Mobile Flutter em nível Júnior/Pleno (perfil intermediário entre as duas senioridades) para atuar na evolução e sustentação dos nossos aplicativos. A senioridade final será definida conforme experiência e aderência técnica. Você vai trabalhar em um squad com foco em qualidade, performance e consistência da experiência do usuário, com acompanhamento e colaboração do time. Esperamos que você tenha paixão por tecnologia, perfil analítico, colaborativo e orientado a aprendizado contínuo.
QUER FAZER PARTE DESTA JORNADA COM A GENTE?
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Desenvolver e evoluir funcionalidades em Flutter (Dart), seguindo boas práticas de código e organização (arquitetura em camadas, Clean Architecture e princípios SOLID).
Implementar telas, fluxos e componentes com atenção a UX, performance e estabilidade, incluindo composição de UIs complexas e widgets customizados.
Integrar o app com APIs REST e serviços de terceiros, garantindo tratamento de erros, autenticação e boa experiência em cenários offline/intermitentes.
Escrever e manter testes automatizados básicos (unitários e/ou widget) quando aplicável.
Atuar na sustentação: correção de bugs, investigação com logs/crash reports e prevenção de regressões.
Participar de code reviews (recebendo e contribuindo), refinamentos, estimativas e cerimônias do time (Scrum/Kanban).
Colaborar com backend, produto e design para alinhamento de requisitos e contratos de integração.
Apoiar a evolução de observabilidade no app (Crashlytics, Analytics, Feature Flags, Remote Config e métricas básicas).
Contribuir com documentação técnica, boas práticas de desenvolvimento
Requisitos e qualificações
REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS:
Experiência prática com Flutter e Dart (profissional ou equivalente que comprove entregas reais).
Experiência consumindo APIs REST e integrando com serviços externos.
Experiência com recursos modernos da linguagem Dart e programação assíncrona (Futures, Streams, async/await).
Vivência com ferramentas da Firebase Suite: Crashlytics e Remote Config.
Conhecimento de Git e rotina de pull request/code review (mesmo que com apoio).
Noções sólidas de qualidade: organização de código, tratamento de erros e atenção a performance.
Conhecimento básico de testes em Flutter (unit/widget) e boas práticas de desenvolvimento mobile.
DIFERENCIAIS:
Experiência com arquitetura no Flutter (Clean Architecture, MVVM, etc.).
Implementação de Design System proprietário, componentes reutilizáveis, tematização
Conhecimento de Firebase (Crashlytics, Analytics, Remote Config, Push).
Experiência com CI/CD mobile (Fastlane, Bitrise, GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps).
Noções de observabilidade e monitoramento em apps.
Experiência com app em produção (mesmo que em menor escala).
Informações adicionais
NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS:
Além de trabalhar no maior grupo de moda do Brasil, focado em impulsionar talentos e especializado em fazer gigante, por aqui você também ganha:
Vale Refeição ou Refeitório;

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (apólice coletiva opcional);
Gympass;
Day-off no seu aniversário para você curtir muito;
Formato híbrido, para você trabalhar de onde quiser;
Até 50% de desconto nas nossas marcas;
Código de Vendedor, com direito a comissão sobre vendas nos sites;
PLR, de acordo com a nossa política;
Vagas de estacionamento e van no fim do dia, para te levar até o metrô mais próximo;
Cursos, palestras e Trilhas de Desenvolvimento, ao vivo e na nossa plataforma de conteúdo;
Avaliação de desempenho;
Muita visibilidade e exposição positiva, pra você conseguir se conectar com todo mundo sem muita hierarquia.
GRUPO SOMA agora É AZZAS 2154 FASHION & LIFESTYLE
Impulsionar o poder criativo da moda brasileira para o mundo
Somos apaixonados por criar, inovar e transformar o mundo da moda com estilo, propósito e gente boa.
Por aqui, acreditamos no poder das ideias, na força da colaboração e na beleza da diversidade. Valorizamos quem faz, quem pensa diferente, quem aprende todos os dias e quem topa evoluir junto.

title: Senior RPA
description:
Job title: Senior RPA (UiPath) Developer
Job type: Contract
Contract Length: 12 months (extension likely)
Rate: $15 - $20 per hour
Role Location: Brazil, Remote
The company: A dynamic technology services firm specializing in robotic process automation (RPA) and digital transformation solutions for clients across industries such as finance, healthcare, and manufacturing. Committed to building innovative digital workforces, the company empowers organizations to streamline operations through advanced automation technologies and tailored consultancy services.
Role And Responsibilities
Design, develop, and implement software robots using RPA platforms to automate business processes, adhering to proprietary methodologies for efficient solution delivery.
Write, test, and debug automation code, ensuring high-quality, error-free robots that meet client requirements and performance standards.
Deploy and maintain orchestration software to manage and monitor bots in production environments, ensuring seamless operation and scalability.
Collaborate with project stakeholders, including business analysts and clients, to gather requirements, define process workflows, and deliver tailored automation solutions.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues in existing automation solutions, optimizing performance and ensuring minimal downtime for client operations.
Contribute to process improvement by identifying automation opportunities and proposing innovative solutions to enhance efficiency.
Document technical designs, test cases, and deployment procedures to support project transparency and client handovers.
Job Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering (required).
2–4 years of experience in software development, preferably with RPA platforms (e.g., UiPath, Automation Anywhere) or related internship/co-op experience.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C#, or VB.NET, and familiarity with automation tools and APIs (e.g., REST, SOAP).
Strong logical thinking, critical reasoning, and problem-solving skills to address complex automation challenges.
Excellent communication and time management skills to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders and meet project deadlines.
Experience with orchestration tools (e.g., UiPath Orchestrator) and process design methodologies is a plus.
Strong academic record or demonstrated work experience in automation or software engineering.
Preferred certifications: UiPath Certified RPA Associate, Automation Anywhere Certified Developer, or equivalent.
Benefits
Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
Professional development opportunities, including RPA training and certification support.
Flexible remote or hybrid work environment with access to collaborative tools.
Opportunity to work on cutting-edge automation projects with global clients.

title: Banco de Talentos: Bombeiro Hidráulico
description:
Esta é a sua porta de entrada para um futuro promissor no maior projeto de modernização de infraestrutura hospitalar do Rio de Janeiro.
Ao cadastrar seu currículo, você entra em nossa rede e poderá ser considerado(a) futuramente para todas as vagas que surgirem durante as próximas contratações.
Na Smart Hospital, acreditamos que a diversidade nos torna mais fortes. Nossas oportunidades são abertas a todos os talentos, com foco total na inclusão de pessoa com deficiência PCD e reabilitados pelo INSS.
Quem somos?
Smart Hospital: Transformando a saúde com inovação. Somos líderes em construção, reforma e operação de infraestrutura hospitalar, pioneiros em modernizar hospitais por meio de parcerias público-privadas. Em parceria com o Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar, o maior hospital de emergência da América Latina, estamos redefinindo os padrões de atendimento em saúde.
O que buscamos?
Um profissional experiente e dedicado para integrar nossa equipe como Bombeiro Hidráulico Gasista. O profissional será responsável pela instalação, manutenção e reparo de tubulações de água, esgoto e, principalmente, de redes e sistemas de gás em edificações, interpretando projetos e garantindo a segurança e a conformidade técnica das instalações.
Dia a Dia
Instalação e reparo de tubulações de água (fria e quente) e esgoto sanitário.
Montagem, construção e manutenção de redes e sistemas de gás em edificações, conforme projetos.
Interpretação de projetos hidráulicos, sanitários e de gás para a correta implantação dos sistemas.
Realização de reparos em canos, vazamentos, sistemas hidráulicos e desobstrução de tubulações e ralos.
Montagem, instalação e manutenção de aquecedores, aparelhos a gás e outros equipamentos.
Utilização de técnicas e equipamentos especializados para identificar e reparar vazamentos de gás, garantindo a segurança.
Execução de testes para verificar a segurança, a ausência de vazamentos e a eficiência das instalações de gás e hidráulicas.
Realização de manutenção de primeiro nível em máquinas e equipamentos utilizados durante os serviços.
Preparação e organização do local de trabalho, garantindo o cumprimento de procedimentos e normas regulamentadoras de saúde, segurança no trabalho e meio ambiente.
Local de atuação: Complexo Hospitalar Municipal Souza Aguiar | Endereço: Praça da República, 111, Centro, Rio de Janeiro
Horário: Temos 2 modelos de jornadas, 44 horas semanais (Segunda a Sexta) e Plantonista 12x36 (Diurno e Noturno).
Requisitos
O que precisamos que você tenha:
Experiência comprovada como Bombeiro Hidráulico/Encanador.
Conhecimento e experiência na instalação e manutenção de sistemas de gás (Gasista).
Curso de Encanador e Bombeiro Hidráulico (ou formação técnica equivalente).
Curso de Gasista.
Habilidade na leitura e interpretação de projetos hidráulicos e de sistemas de gás.
Conhecimento das normas técnicas e regulamentações aplicáveis à instalações hidráulicas, sanitárias e de gás.
Comprometimento com a segurança e com as normas regulamentadoras (NRs).
O Que Vamos Amar Se Você Tiver
Proatividade e capacidade de solucionar problemas de forma autônoma.
Experiência em soldagem (cobre, aço).
Certificações adicionais na área de segurança ou manutenção de equipamentos.
Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e comunicar-se de forma clara.
Benefícios

Alimentação: VA/VR (R$ 25,00/dia) com a flexibilidade de um cartão de crédito, para você escolher onde e como se alimentar.

Convênio com SESC: Oferece acesso a diversas atividades de lazer e cultura, promovendo a qualidade de vida pra você e sua família.

title: agente de operações leves
description:
Descrição da vaga
A Unidas, integrante do grupo Brookfield, é uma das maiores empresas do setor de mobilidade no Brasil.
Conta com cerca de 100 mil ativos entre veículos leves, caminhões, máquinas e equipamentos pesados, e oferece uma plataforma completa de soluções de gestão e locação de veículos, operações e manutenção, trazendo economia e praticidade para pessoas e empresas em todo o país.
Conta também com mais de 200 lojas entre aluguel de carros e venda de seminovos, incluindo leves e pesados, no varejo e atacado.
A companhia, que tem mais de 4 mil colaboradores, é reconhecida como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil pelo ranking Great Place to Work.
Além disso, foi eleita como a 32ª marca mais valiosa pelo Brand Finance Brazil e, por sete vezes, conquistou o Prêmio Consumidor Moderno de Excelência em Serviço ao Cliente na categoria "Locadora de veículos". Avaliar as condições mecânicas dos veículos, acessórios, documentos etc.;

Somos um time que se movimenta em um único sentido: simplificar a vida dos nossos clientes com soluções completas, inovação em aluguel de ativos e serviços confiáveis. Esse é o nosso destino — e a nossa cultura é o veículo que nos leva até lá.

Liderar esforços para promover diversidade e inclusão em todas as metodologias e estudos, garantindo que atendamos às necessidades de todos os consumidores em sua imensa diversidade

Ser pioneiro em novas tecnologias de aprimoramento sensorial para entender melhor o consumidor e a percepção/desempenho de produtos, utilizando ferramentas como realidade aumentada/virtual, ciência comportamental, IA e interação humano-computador, etc.

Liderar colaborações locais e globais dentro de Evaluation Intelligence, L'Oréal R&I Hubs e parceiros externos para desenvolver e implementar as melhores práticas de painel sensorial, novas formas de trabalho e metodologias sensoriais/cognitivas

Experiência de trabalho em um ambiente multicultural internacional e capacidade de pensar globalmente

Capacidade de fornecer insights claros por meio da análise de conjuntos de dados múltiplos/complexos com experiência em análise sensorial/cognitiva, experiência do usuário, Design thinking e comunicação visual

title: Coordenador(a) de Tesouraria
description:
Descrição da vaga
Trabalhar na Norsul é fazer parte da maior empresa privada de cabotagem do Brasil — e contribuir, todos os dias, com o que mantém essa estrutura viva, confiável e em movimento.
Mesmo fora do mar, você está a bordo: garantindo que processos funcionem, decisões aconteçam e a operação siga com consistência, segurança e cuidado.
Aqui, o impacto não está só nos navios — está também em cada planilha, em cada conversa, em cada escolha feita com atenção e responsabilidade.
O que você entrega faz diferença. E o jeito como você entrega também.
Porque na Norsul, pertencer é saber que sua atuação ajuda a sustentar um negócio essencial para o país — e uma cultura feita por gente que se importa.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Responsável por coordenar as atividades de tesouraria da empresa, garantindo a adequada gestão do caixa, fluxo de caixa, capital de giro, endividamento e instrumentos financeiros. Atua no planejamento financeiro de curto e médio prazo, assegurando liquidez, otimização do custo financeiro e cumprimento das obrigações financeiras. Responsável pelo relacionamento com instituições financeiras, negociação de operações de crédito, garantias e câmbio, bem como pelo controle de riscos financeiros e aderência às políticas internas.
Assegura a liquidez e previsibilidade de caixa, equilibrando custo financeiro, risco e suporte às decisões estratégicas do negócio;
Liderar a equipe, desenvolvendo competências, promovendo engajamento, garantindo clareza de responsabilidades e fortalecendo a cultura de controles e confiabilidade das informações;
Coordenar a execução dos processos de pagamentos, dos compromissos financeiros, a serem realizados, no país e no exterior, de acordo com os procedimentos e normas estabelecidas. Mantendo controle dos compromissos financeiros da empresa, confiabilidade e validação do processo de pagamento, dos lançamentos financeiros e contábeis;
Coordenar o fechamento de câmbio em diversas moedas, analisando documentação/sistema e intermediando, por meio da corretora, o pagamento dos compromissos. Assegurando o cumprimento dos compromissos perante os fornecedores no exterior;
Monitorar exposições a riscos de mercado (câmbio, juros, commodities) e propor estratégias de mitigação;
Manter controle da movimentação bancária diária, apurando saldos e lançamentos bancários, garantindo a validação do fluxo de caixa através do acompanhamento, análise e atualização do fluxo de caixa realizado e previsto;
Contatar fornecedores e instituições financeiras para solução de pendências relacionadas a pagamentos;
Assessorar a gerência quanto com relação as demandas da Diretoria;
Aplicar ou resgatar os recursos necessários a operação da empresa;
Executar o processo de pagamento dos financiamentos do BNDES;
Gerir o relacionamento com bancos e instituições financeiras, negociando limites, tarifas, linhas de crédito e serviços;
Coordenar operações de crédito, garantias bancárias, fianças, cartas de crédito e instrumentos similares;
Avaliar e propor novas estruturas financeiras, buscando melhores condições de custo e prazo;
Controlar o endividamento da companhia, acompanhando saldo, cronograma de amortização, juros e covenants;
Analisar e reportar indicadores de alavancagem, custo da dívida e exposição financeira;
Apoiar processos de captação, rolagem, renegociação ou liquidação de dívidas;
Auxiliar usuários do Microsiga (Protheus) no modulo financeiro quando solicitado.
Requisitos e qualificações
Superior completo em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis, ou afins;
Experiência em rotinas de tesouraria, conciliação bancária, contas a pagar e receber, gestão financeira, fluxo de caixa, pagamentos internacionais, Pagamentos FMM/BNDES, garantias bancárias (fiança) e aplicações financeiras;
Fluxo de caixa direto e indireto, investimentos financeiros, cotações de taxas financeiras, análise de investimento câmbio, produtos financeiros, elaboração de relatórios gerenciais.

Não buscamos perfeição nem fórmulas prontas. O que conta é o compromisso em construir junto, com responsabilidade, clareza e parceria.

Ela se revela no jeito de colaborar, de ensinar, de aprender — e de manter a operação fluindo com confiança mútua.
Com mais de 60 anos de história, transportamos bauxita, minério de ferro, celulose e muito mais — conectando rotas no Brasil e no exterior, com segurança, consistência e compromisso com um futuro mais sustentável.

title: Intelligence Analyst
description:
Overview

170 Years Strong. Industry Leader. Global Impact.At Pinkerton, the mission is to protect our clients. To do this, we provide enterprise risk management services and programs specifically designed for each client. Pinkerton employees are one of our most important assets and critical to the delivery of world-class solutions. Bonded together, we share a commitment to integrity, vigilance, and excellence.

Pinkerton is an inclusive employer who seeks candidates with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to join our family of industry subject matter experts.

The Intelligence Analyst, assigned to a specific client, will monitor, evaluate, and interpret data from various sources to identify threats and risks that may affect the company, its employees, or reputation. The Analyst produces timely intelligence through event and trend analysis, supports crisis response, and provides actionable insights for decision-making.

Responsibilities

  • Represent Pinkerton's core values of integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
  • Monitor open sources (OSINT) including press, intelligence subscriptions, social media to identify threats/risks that may impact the client's operations, employees, and reputation.
  • Manage the collection of intelligence information used to populate situational reports and risk assessments.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to gather intelligence and insights on threat actors, their tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
  • Regularly update threat profiles to reflect the latest information and changes in the threat landscape.
  • Support executive protection and travel security by proving threat assessments and reporting.
  • Assist with the periodic updating of standard operational procedures (SOPs), produce After Action Reports, and create playbooks and risk matrices to strengthen organizational resilience.
  • Establish and maintain systematic, cross referenced intelligence records and files.
  • Initiate, execute, and maintain intelligence relationships inside and outside the organization.
  • Safeguard and maintain highly sensitive and confidential information.
  • All other duties, as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree with 3 years of risk analysis and/or intelligence experience.

  • Bilingual written and verbal skills; English and Portuguese. Spanish is optional.
  • Knowledge and understanding of intelligence-gathering techniques.
  • Able to identify risks by analyzing data and information from multiple unrelated sources into a finished comprehensive intelligence product.
  • Client orientated and results driven.
  • Able to work independently with little supervision and under adverse and stressful conditions.
  • Able to present and defend intelligence positions to a variety of audiences and stakeholders.
  • Able to interact collaboratively at all levels of an organization.
  • Serve as a positive team member.
  • Maintain confidentiality when dealing with sensitive information.
  • Able to manage multiple projects simultaneously with competing priorities and deadlines.
  • Computer skills; Microsoft Office.

Working Conditions:

With or without reasonable accommodation, requires the physical and mental capacity to effectively perform all essential functions;

  • Regular computer usage.
  • Occasional reaching and lifting of small objects and operating office equipment.
  • Frequent sitting.
  • Travel, as required.

title: Security Specialist
description:
Who Are We?
Decentralized Masters is at the forefront of DeFi education globally. In just two years, we have grown from a pioneering pair of co-founders to over 130 dedicated professionals. Today, we are recognized as one of the fastest-growing enterprises in the sector, with industry insiders predicting our evolution into a unicorn company by 2030. Operating on a bootstrapped model, we are on track to achieve an impressive $50 million in revenue this year alone.
Our Impact
While our growth has been remarkable, we take even greater pride in the success of our clients. To date, we have empowered over 4000 investors to break into the DeFi world. At Decentralized Masters, we don't just offer education; we cultivate a powerhouse of knowledge combined with an engaging community, innovative technology, and a team of leading DeFi and blockchain experts. Our commitment is to deliver unparalleled resources designed for long-term success in the world of DeFi and Web3, ensuring our members not only safeguard but also enhance their financial future.
Our Vision
Our goal is to create the largest and most influential DeFi ecosystem the world has ever seen, starting with becoming the gold standard in DeFi education. This vision is ambitious, transformative, and poised to change the landscape of digital finance.
Are You Ready?
This is more than just a job; it's an opportunity to shape the future of Web3 technology and education. Are you ready to be part of our vision to redefine what's possible in DeFi and beyond? Apply below, and let's explore this journey together.
Check us out here:
What will you be doing?
We are seeking a Security Specialist to develop, maintain, and continuously improve the security infrastructure across Decentralized Masters and our new SaaS venture. This role focuses on operational security, data protection, risk prevention, and proactive threat mitigation.
You'll work cross-functionally with engineering, data protection, compliance, operations, and product teams to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of our systems, data, and customer assets.
This is a hands-on role, ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment.
Key Responsibilities
Operational & Technical Security
Monitor, analyze, and respond to security events across systems, cloud environments, applications, and internal tools
Implement and manage SIEM, IDS/IPS, endpoint protection, vulnerability scanners, and logging infrastructure
Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and coordinate remediation with engineering teams
Oversee secure configuration baselines for infrastructure, servers, cloud accounts, and internal systems
Implement and enforce Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies, tools, and controls to prevent unauthorized data transfers, including hands-on work with data classification and monitoring systems
Perform detailed data flow mapping to understand how customer data moves across internal systems, SaaS apps, APIs, and third-party integrations
Cloud Security
Secure cloud environments (AWS preferred) including data at rest and in transit using encryption and cloud-native security tools
Manage cloud access policies, network segmentation, secrets management, and continuous monitoring
Risk Management & Compliance
Support compliance frameworks including GDPR, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and crypto-specific security standards as required
Develop and maintain internal security policies, procedures, and security controls
Partner with the Data Protection & Information Security Officer to ensure alignment across security, privacy, and data governance
Access & Identity Management
Serve as the Access & Control Monitoring expert, managing IAM, RBAC policies, least-privilege access, MFA, and anomaly detection systems
Perform regular access reviews, privilege audits, and segregation-of-duty checks
Maintain strong audit logging practices and monitoring of access behavior
Security Awareness & Culture
Deliver training, simulations, and internal education to strengthen internal security awareness
Lead phishing simulation programs and social engineering prevention initiatives
Incident Response
Lead the incident response process: detection, escalation, containment, investigation, and post-incident review
Maintain and improve the incident response playbook; run annual and quarterly tabletop exercises
Secure Development & SaaS Security (Bonus)
Collaborate with engineering teams to embed secure-by-design practices into our SaaS products
Conduct application security reviews, threat modeling, and code analysis (bonus)
Contribute to architecture decisions for new features and infrastructure
Requirements
What You Will Bring
Must-Have
3+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information security, or security operations
Hands-on experience with Data Loss Prevention (DLP) tools and data classification frameworks
Strong data flow mapping expertise with the ability to trace data across systems, integrations, and APIs
Solid understanding of cloud security concepts, encryption, and cloud-native security tools (AWS preferred)
Expertise in IAM and Access Control Monitoring, including least-privilege models, RBAC, MFA, and anomaly detection
Familiarity with audit logging, SIEM tools, vulnerability management, and endpoint security
Experience with incident response processes and playbooks
Strong understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, threat actors, and common attack vectors
Working knowledge of compliance standards such as GDPR, SOC 2, and data protection regulations
Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical teams
Nice-to-Have
Experience working in fintech, blockchain, or DeFi environments
Familiarity with cryptographic concepts, wallets, smart contracts, or key-management practices
Certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GSEC, GCIH, OSCP, CCSP, or similar
Experience automating security workflows using scripting languages
Exposure to ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II audits, or similar security frameworks
Benefits
What We Offer
Competitive salary package
Flexible 40-hour workweek
Unlimited PTO and flexible work schedules
Team off-sites and events
Fully remote work setup — join our global team from anywhere
Are You Ready?
This is more than a job; it's an opportunity to shape the future of Web3 education and finance. If you're a visionary leader ready to drive our mission and help us achieve unicorn status, we want to hear from you.
Apply now to join us in redefining what's possible in DeFi and beyond.
